title: aneilema divergens
intro: Aneilema divergens, commonly known as African velvet plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Commelinaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Aneilema divergens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
